classification_basis: Gate (ii) failed on end_obj_trans_err, so the preregistered classification is eval-consistency-null by the letter of the gate. The label's attached rationale -- 'step-0 frame consistency contributes nothing substantive to the metrics' -- is CONTRADICTED by the measurement: the frame rule moved 7 of 14 metrics significantly, including mpjpe by 4.43 cm and obj_trans_dist by 6.92. The classification is recorded unchanged because gates are not rewritten after the results are seen; the contradiction is recorded beside it.
conclusion_on_the_m9_confound: ESTABLISHED: the step-0 frame rule is a first-order factor -- 7 of 14 metrics significant, all favouring the repaired rule, none favouring the historical one. This confirms the preregistered 'evaluation consistency' half of the expected benefit directly. NOT ESTABLISHED: any decomposition of the PRIMARY-minus-D2AI delta. The frame factor's effects are 7-14x those deltas, so the PRIMARY row must stand as a new baseline and must not be read as an improvement over D2-AI. The 4 penetration terms and foot_sliding show no detectable frame effect, but their confidence intervals contain the observed deltas, so the control can neither confirm nor exclude the frame rule for them; the +13% penetration regression remains unexplained.

control_cell.interpretive_limit: CONTROL is an out-of-distribution insult -- a model trained under the repaired rule fed a historical frame at 77.83 deg -- whereas D2-AI was self-consistently historical at 50.12 deg (trained under B, evaluated under A). So CONTROL bounds the evaluator's share but does NOT decompose the D2-AI delta: the frame factor's effects are 7-14x the observed PRIMARY-minus-D2AI deltas, i.e. the bound is loose by about an order of magnitude.
control_cell.launched_directly: tools/hoi_chain.py's stage_completed() keys on the stage name not the eval run id, so a second --stages evaluate silently skips; the command is byte-for-byte hoi_chain.evaluate_command plus the one override
control_cell.mechanism: same checkpoint, same data, only the step-0 window frame; +dataset.step0_frame_rule=historical_conjugated
